backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ToolShare platform defining data types (UserProfile, ToolListing, RentalRequest, ChatMessage) and state management for profiles, tools, rentals, and chats with access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to removing the zoom ceiling in CustomMapView and useMapTiles, fixing tile URL computation for high zoom levels, and capping max zoom to 19 in useMapTransform.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and recent changes of each page, component, hook, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite app, setting the page title to 'ToolShare - Community Tool Sharing Platform' and mounting the React app via src/main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Minimal README for the ToolShare frontend identifying it as a community tool-sharing platform built on the Internet Computer with a Getting Started section stub.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes including the community map, wraps the app in ThemeProvider, and renders the RouterProvider with a Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity that handles authentication state, shows a loading spinner during login, and clears the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard component that renders a login prompt card when the user is unauthenticated and renders its children when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Renders a split-panel community map UI with a custom map view on the left and a scrollable member list sidebar on the right, supporting member selection and a floating info card for the selected member.
frontend/src/components/community/Custom: A custom tile-based interactive map component that renders community member markers, supports pan/zoom via pointer and wheel events, and auto-fits the viewport to member coordinates.
Renders an SVG teardrop map pin marker for a community member, displaying their avatar or initials, with visual states for selected and current-user conditions.
frontend/src/components/community/SetCoo: A dialog form that geocodes a user-entered address via Nominatim and saves the resulting coordinates to the user's profile, allowing them to appear on the community map.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: A canvas-based animation layer that renders drifting 3D-style floating objects (orbs, rings, faceted shapes, tori) with parallax motion and reduced-motion support for the landing page background.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: A wrapper component that applies a 3D perspective tilt effect based on mouse position, with a radial highlight overlay, disabled automatically for touch devices and reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: A thin wrapper around an HTML img element with lazy loading defaults and a runtime warning if alt text is missing, used for landing page illustrations.
A landing page section displaying a two-column layout with community tool library marketing copy, stats, and a hero illustration image.
frontend/src/components/landing/Toolshed: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: A sticky app header with the ToolShare logo, navigation links (conditionally shown when authenticated), login button, and a mobile slide-out menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: A layout wrapper that composes AppHeader, a main content area, and AppFooter into a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: A reusable page header component rendering a title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: A simple container wrapper that applies consistent padding and container styling to page content.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: A filter bar for the browse page with inputs for search text, category, sort order, min/max price, and an availability toggle.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: A camera capture UI component that activates the device camera, handles errors/permissions, and returns a captured photo as a data URL.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: A responsive grid of tool listing cards showing photo, title, category, description, location, and availability status with links to detail pages.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: A dropdown menu component shown only to the listing owner, providing options to edit the listing or toggle its availability.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: A form field component for managing photo references that supports adding photos via URL input or camera capture, and displays them in a grid with removal functionality.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active conversation panel for a selected rental, showing tool details, rental dates, status badge, and the chat interface via RentalChatPanel.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations, each showing tool title, counterpart user role/name, and status badge, with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: A styled navigation link wrapper around TanStack Router's Link that applies active/inactive color classes for consistent nav styling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: A dropdown menu component showing the authenticated user's avatar with options to view their profile or log out.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to create one by entering display name, contact info, location, and address.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: A chat panel component for rental conversations that loads and displays messages, distinguishes own vs. others' messages, and supports sending new messages via Enter key or button.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: A form component that allows users to submit a rental request for a tool by selecting start and end dates, with validation and IC nanosecond timestamp conversion.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders action buttons (Approve/Decline, Cancel, Complete) for a rental based on the current status and whether the user is the owner or renter, with confirmation dialogs and toast notifications on status update.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Displays a centered card with an icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an empty state in the UI.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive-styled card with an alert icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an error state in the UI.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Renders a centered spinner with an optional message to indicate a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTiles.ts: Calculates the set of map tiles needed to fill a viewport given a center coordinate and zoom level, using Web Mercator math and CartoDB tile URLs, and provides a lat/lng-to-pixel conversion function.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Manages map pan and zoom state with pointer drag handling, sanitizing coordinates to valid Web Mercator ranges and exposing zoom in/out/reset controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Provides simple zoom state management with zoom in/out/reset actions and a wheel event handler, independent of map tile logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Tracks mouse position and scroll offset to produce parallax motion values, respecting the user's reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns a boolean indicating whether the user has requested reduced motion via the OS/browser media query, updating reactively on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend actor calls including user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, and community map profiles, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Custom hook that detects WebGL support by attempting to create a canvas context, returning isSupported, isChecking, and error state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark color themes using OKLCH values, and adds utility classes for 3D transforms and reduced-motion overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page component for browsing tool listings with filter/search controls (category, price range, availability, sort) and a responsive listings grid.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Authenticated page that displays a map of community member locations, with options to add or update the current user's coordinates via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section, how-it-works steps, feature cards, and interactive tilt/floating-object visual components, adapting CTAs based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single tool listing showing photos, category/condition badges, pricing, and conditionally rendering a rental request form for renters or owner action controls for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: A form page for creating or editing a tool listing, with fields for title, category, description, condition, pricing, location, availability, and photos. Supports both 'create' and 'edit' modes, pre-populating fields from existing data when editing.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Displays a messaging interface showing conversations tied to the user's rentals, with a conversations list and an active conversation panel side by side. Requires authentication and shows empty/loading states as needed.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Lists all rental requests and bookings where the current user is the renter, showing tool details, dates, status badges, and action buttons. Requires authentication and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's tool listings along with alerts for pending rental requests and active rentals. Provides navigation to add a new listing and links to manage requests.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays and allows editing of the authenticated user's profile, including display name, contact info, location, profile picture, and address. Supports toggling edit mode via a URL parameter and saves changes via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific rental request, including tool details, dates, cost breakdown, status badge, and a chat panel. Determines owner/renter roles from the current identity and renders appropriate status actions.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Displays incoming rental requests for the authenticated user's tools, showing each request as a card with status badge, dates, and action buttons. Uses RequireAuth and ProfileSetupDialog for access control and onboarding.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Exports a single async utility function that converts a File object to a base64 data URL string using the FileReader API.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides utilities for equirectangular (flat map) projection, including coordinate validation, converting lat/lon to x/y screen percentages, and parsing coordinate strings.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Provides utilities for 3D globe projection using Three.js, including converting lat/lon to a Vector3 on a sphere surface, coordinate validation, and coordinate string parsing.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Exports date formatting helpers for rental timestamps (stored as nanosecond bigints), including short date, long date, chat-style relative timestamp, and rental duration in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Defines color and label mappings for all RentalStatus enum values and exports helper functions to retrieve them, used for rendering status badges.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Exports two functions to format a user's join timestamp: one returning a human-readable duration since joining (e.g., '3 months') and one returning a formatted join date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the ToolShare project's current state, including a summary of a map zoom fix request, existing zoom-related features targeting CartoDB Voyager tile provider zoom level 19, and a pending feature request for Google Maps-style deep zoom.
